description_en: Modifies the name or description of the specified host group
description_zh: 修改资产组名称或备注信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-host-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHostGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的资产组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to modify.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的资产组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group that you want to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html operation to query the ID of the host group
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的资产组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_group_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the asset group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的资产组名称，最多支持128字符
parameters.name: host_group_name

parameters.help_en: The new remarks of the asset group. The remarks can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的资产组备注信息，最多支持500字符
parameters.name: comment

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
